Author: Replica
Name: Monitor
Description: A key that switches a monitor between two inputs over DDC/CI, and a key that runs Panel Protect on an MSI OLED monitor and counts down.

Actions.Name: Switch Input
Actions.Tooltip: Press to switch the monitor between two inputs. Pick the inputs in the key's settings.

Actions.Name: Panel Protect
Actions.Tooltip: Press to run Panel Protect (pixel refresh) on the MSI OLED monitor over USB. The key counts down 15 minutes; press again to clear it.
